eval.description: Anthropic human uplift trial: PhD-level biologists (without bioweapons expertise) write an end-to-end protocol to recover a challenging virus from synthetic DNA, with or without model help. Graders use a multi-point rubric with critical-failure gates. Cards report mean critical failures (lower is stronger uplift) and sometimes fractional plan scores; some runs add agentic model-only arms.
eval.summary: Measures how much the model helps biologists plan the recovery of a dangerous virus.
